To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the persistence strategies of organisms of different complexity are organized along three axes of a persistence triangle, which can be explained by the scope-umwelt-gap framework.

the persistence strategies of flexibility, robustness and economy are general to all organisms, that the persistence triangle is a general model of organismal persistence, and that the persistence strategies and the domains of life are related in a general way.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the evolution of the domains of life and the persistence strategies of organisms.
the persistence of organisms in the face of environmental change.
the general principles of persistence and survival in biological systems.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the persistence strategy of a biological lineage is determined by the intersection of its umwelt and scope.
the domains are not defined by the nature of their genomes but by the nature of the persistence strategies that are used to process the information contained in the genome.
life is a matter-energy-information processing phenomenon that is shaped by environmental forces.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the division of organisms into superkingdoms reflects a general framework of persistence strategies that can be applied to the study of life.
domains of life are the result of the evolution of persistence strategies in the space and time of the environment.
the persistence strategies of organisms can be explained by their complexity, which is a function of the number of components and interactions in an organism’s internal network.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the persistence triangle provides a general framework for the study of the domains of life and the evolution of biological systems.
the persistence strategies of organisms can be quantified, and their use can be explained by the properties of their constituent molecules.
persistence strategies are general, and they can help explain the domains of life.
